name: 弗氏鷗
illustrationTaxon: Leucophaeus pipixcan: 32-36 cm, a small gull with a dark grey mantle and dark legs. Adult in breeding plumage has a black head and may show a pink wash on the chest; adult in non-breeding plumage has dark grey around the eye that reaches the hind crown, with white crescents above and below the eye, a white neck and underparts and a clean white tail. Adult upperwings are dark grey with white-tipped outer primaries that have black subterminal bands and white internally. First-year birds are darker brownish-grey on the upperwing (browner on the coverts) with broad white tips to the secondaries and inner primaries, a dark tail band, rather extensive dark grey on the rear of the head and broad white crescents around the eye.

similarSpecies.distinction: 紅嘴鷗（37–43 公分）比本種大，**嘴與腳都是鮮紅色**，本種嘴黑、腳深色；紅嘴鷗的繁殖頭罩是整頂深褐色，本種非繁殖羽只在眼周有一塊**深灰耳斑向後連到後冠**，眼上下各有一彎白新月。紅嘴鷗翼上淡灰、翼尖黑色，本種翼上深灰、外側初級飛羽黑底白端。
小鷗（25–30 公分）比本種小一截，是本地最小的鷗；繁殖羽整頂純黑頭罩**沒有眼圈**，本種非繁殖羽是深灰耳斑配**上下兩彎白新月**。小鷗腳深紅、翼下整片深灰，本種腳深黑、翼上深灰而翼下較淡。

featureNotes: 非繁殖羽的眼周是一整塊深灰，向後延伸並向上接到後冠，與白色的額、頰、頸側形成清楚邊界；繁殖羽才是整頂黑頭（第1圈取自大頭圖，實際可見頭罩後緣、白頰與嘴基都在圈內）。
眼下與眼上各有一彎乾淨的白新月，把深灰耳斑切成三塊；這是本種非繁殖羽最好用的辨識點（第2圈取自大頭圖，實際可見）。
嘴短而黑、整體一個顏色、尖端略鉤，嘴基與白色額部相接；紅嘴鷗的嘴更長而且是鮮紅色（第3圈取自大頭圖，整支嘴由嘴基到尖端都在圈內）。
收翼側面：次級飛羽與內側初級飛羽都是黑底配**白色端斑**，外側初級飛羽的黑色更實、白端更明顯，下方白尾與尾端深帶亦入鏡；HKBWS 形容成鳥初級飛羽是「黑底、內側白、白端」（第4圈取自全身圖，實際可見）。

sources.use: HKBWS substantive read: Category I, Accidental; 32-36 cm, a small gull with a dark grey mantle and dark legs; breeding plumage has a black head and may have a pink wash on the chest; non-breeding plumage has dark grey around the eye that reaches the hind crown; adult has white-tipped outer primaries with black subterminal bands and white internally; first-year birds are rather dark brownish-grey on the upperwing (browner on the coverts) with broad white tips to the secondaries and inner primaries, a dark tail band, rather extensive dark grey on the rear of the head and broad white crescents around the eye; calls are rather high-pitched and often inflected, kyer or kyeeear; all Hong Kong sightings occurred on the intertidal mudflats of Deep Bay; 2015: a second-winter from 26 November to 2 May 2016 (Lewthwaite 2017) joined by a second bird from 19 April to 2 May; no observations on behaviour, foraging and diet; monotypic, breeding in the interior of central North America and wintering along the west seaboard of South America (Burger and Gochfeld 2020); in China there are records from Tianjin, Hebei, Zhejiang and Taiwan (Liu and Chen 2020); IUCN Least Concern with the population trend increasing.

HKBWS Black-headed Gull page read as the first contrast species: 37-43 cm, dark brown breeding hood, bold complete white eye ring, deep red bill and legs, black-tipped outer primaries with a white leading edge.

HKBWS Little Gull page read as the second contrast species: 25-30 cm, the smallest gull, black breeding hood with no eye crescents, fine black bill, deep red legs, dark grey underwings and a broad white trailing edge on both wing surfaces.
Hong Kong List 2024: 弗氏鷗 Leucophaeus pipixcan is listed as 181, Category I, with no IUCN code in the list, i.e. Least Concern, matching the HKBWS species page.

Cornell Lab (All About Birds) read for ecology beyond Hong Kong: nests in freshwater marshes with emergent vegetation in large colonies; omnivorous, eating mainly insects, earthworms and other invertebrates, and on wintering grounds also small fish, crabs and isopods along shorelines and around fishing operations; winters mostly along ocean coastlines of South America; highly social and sensitive to disturbance.

notes: AI 生成插圖，經人眼核對深灰耳斑連後冠、眼上下白新月、短黑嘴、翼的白後緣白翼尖。
畫的是**非繁殖羽（冬季）**：眼周深灰向後延伸至後冠，眼上、眼下各一彎白新月，嘴黑、腳深黑；HKBWS 明寫繁殖羽是整頂黑頭、胸前可能帶粉紅——卡面所畫不是繁殖羽，notes 在此寫明差別（第 1、2 圈說明的也是非繁殖羽特徵）。
身長：HKBWS 量 **32–36 cm**；app 的 `explorerIndex.len` 為 0、`cardDetails` 無長度欄位，slim 版面亦不顯示身長，故卡面沒有身長數字，notes 只記 HKBWS 的區間，沒有自行補值（0014／0053 前例）。體重兩邊都無資料，不填。

**IUCN 來源錯誤已改正**：`cardDetails.zh.json` 原寫「未評估 NE」，但 HKBWS 物種頁明寫 **Least Concern、趨勢 increasing**，HK List 2024 的弗氏鷗一列亦無 IUCN 代碼（即 LC）。依 0185／0188 前例只改這一個 `iucn` 字串（brace scan + `str.replace`，沒有重新序列化整份檔案），再跑 `scripts/build-dex-scores.mjs` 與 `scripts/cards/build-filter-traits.mjs`；eBird／Cornell 的 BBS 長期下降數字屬區域趨勢，沒有寫進卡面 IUCN 章。

app 分數：改 IUCN 後由 `i 2.6／a 2.3／v 4.5／r 1.0／c 1.5／o 2.4` 變成 **`i 2.0／a 2.3／v 4.5／r 1.0／c 1.2／o 2.2`**，`vEst: 1` 仍在：體長由 AVONET 翼長估算（`explorerIndex.len` 是 0），卡面已標「觀賞值含體長估算」。食性 tag 只有 `insect`、棲地 tag 為空，適應力 2.3 照原值顯示，沒有替缺資料補值。
香港紀錄照 HKBWS 只有一筆（2015-11-26 至 2016-05-02 的一隻第二個冬季鳥，2016-04-19 至 05-02 有第二隻加入），兩隻都在后海灣潮間帶泥灘；分類為單型種。
叫聲照 HKBWS：偏高、尾音帶轉折的「kyer」或「kyeeear」。行為、覓食與食性 HKBWS 寫「No observations」，卡面不補；Cornell 的北美生態資料只在來源列註明，沒有寫成香港情況。

地圖 14 個 ISO3：北美洲內陸的**繁殖國家**（CAN、USA）＋南美洲西岸的**度冬國家**（COL、ECU、PER、CHL），再加上遷徙與度冬所經的中美洲與墨西哥（MEX、BLZ、GTM、SLV、HND、NIC、CRI、PAN；MEX 只是遷徙／零星度冬，不是繁殖國）。中國（天津、河北、浙江）與台灣的紀錄都是**迷鳥**，香港的一筆也是偶發紀錄，所以 CHN／TWN／HKG 都不上綠色；綠色非全境、非完整分佈。
